description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a reputable Skilled Nursing Facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity for an experienced Registered Nurse passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment.
The ideal candidate will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives. This role offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting the importance of this position and the expertise required.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility or Long-Term Care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing nursing facilities
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
